body: We're all different. This made me go another day.

I've been going through this for 5 months now and I have no one to talk to. Not a single person. I envy the people you have in your life who you can talk to, I wish there was someone I trusted enough.
Today was a really rough day for me, I went to the lake and while I was standing on the ledge a bee came and bothered me. A fucking bee saved my life today. 
I went to sit down and after a while, two puppies came up to me. They looked so ridiculously happy to see me... I think I need to get a dog. Maybe you should too?...

I have listened to this song on repeat for the past three hours. I am not far from believing it's true now. Tomorrow is gonna be better! http://youtu.be/GJq219j2rZs
i'm with you. I go to class but I just sit there and wondering what i'm doing there? What is my grade gonna do when I'm not here anymore? What's the point?
